exact_console_error.text: Error synchronizing filesystem from IndexDB: [object Object] (errno: 44)

source_guarantees: Uno.StorageFolder initiates one populate sync, a beforeunload write sync, and periodic write sync every 10000 milliseconds. Its isSynchronizing flag guards new calls only until the FS.syncfs callback clears that flag.

The exact FS.syncfs implementation invokes its callback on the first mount error, while other mounts or IndexedDB transactions may still be active. The callback is not an all-mounts-settled boundary after failure.
The error message is shared by populate and write synchronization; its wording does not identify which direction failed.
IDBFS.syncfs snapshots local paths synchronously, then obtains remote entries through asynchronous IndexedDB cursor callbacks before reconciliation.
Reconciliation reloads selected local entries using FS.lookupPath and FS.stat; an exception is propagated through the same synchronization callback.
This exact native runtime throws error 44 from the MEMFS missing-child lookup implementation.

The application recovery timer runs every 20 seconds; recovery writes a temporary file asynchronously and then renames it, with conditional temporary-file deletion and recovery-file deletion also present.
runtime_source_trace.grounded_possible_mechanism: A temporary or deleted recovery path present in the local snapshot can disappear while remote enumeration is pending, before reconciliation reloads that path. This follows from the reviewed source interleaving but is not proven to be the path or operation observed in this run.
missing_attribution: The console record does not retain the failing filesystem path.
The console record does not retain populate direction or an error stack.
No deterministic reproduction has been run and no environment/transient classification is established.
runtime_source_trace.retry_limitation: An immediate FS.syncfs retry from the first error callback can overlap still-active mount synchronization. No retry, suppression or runtime hook is proposed by this audit.

limits: All original shard and aggregate bytes are retained. The strict full matrix remains failed, with no runtime-error exemption or rerun.
The original aggregate stops at the failed shard header. Separate immutable-harness audits recalculate all 144 retained PNG states and preserve the 69 passing/3 rejected comparison outcomes.
The three rejected clip comparisons have diagnostic-only native pixel results within the original thresholds; these do not override the original fatal filesystem synchronization error.
No pixels exceeded the unchanged luminance-12 threshold in scored regions; this does not assert byte-identical images.
The missing filesystem path, populate direction and error stack were not logged, so the observed storage error has no established root cause or transient classification.

This is the explicit legacy versus legacy-composite pair at source 0ffa; current composite versus persistent quality, no-query startup/reload, hardware performance and default promotion remain separate qualifications.

aot.qualification_scope: The explicit AOT Welcome/lifecycle matrix passed. The complete SVG scene attempt failed its original runtime gate in the legacy DPR 2 clip control: 47 of 48 cases and 69 of 72 strict comparisons pass. Matching diagnostic-only clip pixels do not override the filesystem synchronization error. No hardware performance or current-default promotion is inferred.

independent_visual_review.scope: Representative native AOT screenshots; supplements the complete automated pixel audit.
independent_visual_review.finding: Artwork, gradients and text are present. The selection box, handles and five selected objects are consistent. Native chrome and rulers are crisp. Cropping in the 100% view matches the actual-size camera rather than missing content.

provenance_limitations: The Interpreter job built its own separate package and retained its complete source/build/font manifest, but did not upload the Interpreter package ZIP. The job log proves the exact source and equivalent harness trees, explicit Interpreter publish setting and uploaded quality-artifact digest; this audit does not claim independent verification of a retained Interpreter binary archive.

The Interpreter observations do not establish AOT correctness, full SVG-scene coverage, hardware GPU performance, default-mode startup/reload behavior, or performance recovery. Those qualifications require their own actual artifacts.

The AOT Welcome evidence uses the explicit legacy and legacy-composite selectors. It does not establish the full SVG-scene matrix, no-query default startup/reload, hardware GPU behavior or performance recovery; those require their own actual artifacts.

The original 21ee AOT SVG aggregate rejects its failed DPR 2 shard before aggregate native recalculation. Independent immutable-harness audits inspect all 144 retained PNG states and preserve all 72 comparison outcomes, including three rejected by the runtime gate. The exact IndexedDB error lacks a path, populate direction or stack; no root cause or transient classification is established, and no error exemption or rerun is used.
